content: I will modify `src/lib/constants.ts` to add all the route paths for the Hub and its submenus, and update the default `DASHBOARD` route to point to `/hub` so that users are automatically shown the Hub upon logging in.

args.Description: Add Hub and submenu route constants, change default dashboard to hub
